_comment: MITRE ATT&CK mapping for ThreatScope. Each key is a CICIDS2017 label. Techniques sourced from MITRE ATT&CK v14 (https://attack.mitre.org). Do not fabricate technique IDs.

DDoS.description: Adversary performs a volumetric flood from a botnet or single source to exhaust target bandwidth or connection tables.

DoS Hulk.description: HTTP-based flood tool (Hulk) exhausts web server resources by generating unique GET requests that bypass caches.

DoS GoldenEye.description: Layer-7 HTTP DoS tool that keeps connections alive using Keep-Alive headers to exhaust server connection pools.

DoS slowloris.description: Slowloris sends partial HTTP requests to hold connections open indefinitely, exhausting the server's connection pool.

DoS Slowhttptest.description: Slow HTTP attack tool similar to Slowloris but targets POST body or Range headers to hold server connections.

PortScan.description: Adversary scans for open ports and running services to map the network and identify attack surfaces.

FTP-Patator.description: Patator tool used to brute-force FTP credentials through repeated login attempts.

SSH-Patator.description: Patator tool used to brute-force SSH credentials through repeated login attempts.

Bot.description: Botnet client communicating with C2 infrastructure. May also perform scanning, credential theft, or spam.

Web Attack - Brute Force.description: Web-based brute force attack against authentication forms (HTTP POST).

Web Attack - XSS.description: Cross-Site Scripting injection into web application inputs to execute malicious scripts in victim browsers.

Web Attack - SQL Injection.description: SQL injection attacks to extract, modify, or delete data from back-end databases.

Heartbleed.description: Exploitation of CVE-2014-0160 (OpenSSL Heartbleed) to read server memory, potentially exposing private keys and credentials.

Infiltration.description: Adversary exploits a vulnerability to gain foothold inside the network and moves laterally.
